preconditions.description: The number of lines of input is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each line of input is a command of at most 100 characters, consisting of one or more words separated by spaces and ending with a period.
preconditions.description: Each command is a sequence of one or more words. Each word uses only lower and uppercase characters a–z. Each pair of words is separated by a single space. The command ends in a period.

preconditions.expression: The phrase 'Simon says' only occurs at the beginning of a command.
preconditions.description: If a command begins with 'Simon says', there is another space and at least one additional word after 'says'.

postconditions.expression: For each line that begins with precisely 'Simon says', output the rest of the line.
postconditions.description: Each line that does not begin with precisely 'Simon says' should be ignored.
